meaning:

His political commentary is sharp but surprisingly fair, which explains why many rival newspapers still regularly quote him. (他的政治評論犀利卻意外公正，這說明了為何許多競爭報紙仍經常引用他的話。)

This species commonly nests near wetlands where food and shelter remain available throughout the year. (這個物種通常在濕地附近築巢，那裡全年都有食物與遮蔽處。)

meaning: adj. 善於溝通的；交際的
example: Communicative teaching activities encourage learners to exchange ideas and ask meaningful questions. (溝通式教學活動鼓勵學習者交流想法，並提出有意義的問題。)

meaning:
n. 共產主義者；共產黨員

example: The museum displayed posters that explained how communist movements influenced regional history. (博物館展示說明共產主義運動如何影響區域歷史的海報。)

meaning:
adj. 小巧的；緊湊的
vt. 壓緊；使緊密

Rents in the capital are comparable to those in other major European cities. (首都的租金與其他歐洲主要城市相近。)
A recent comparative study found that older patients often recovered faster at home than in large traditional hospitals. (一項近期比較研究發現，年長病人在家往往比在大型傳統醫院恢復得更快。)
The airline agreed to compensate all passengers for the unexpected long delay. (航空公司同意就意外的長時間延誤補償所有乘客。)
Language competence develops through practice, feedback, and regular exposure to authentic conversations. (語言能力透過練習、回饋與定期接觸真實對話逐步發展。)

meaning: adj. 有能力的；能勝任的
example: She is a competent manager who always listens carefully to her staff. (她是個能勝任的管理者，會仔細聆聽員工的意見。)

meaning:
n. 補充物；互補之物
vt. 補充；使相得益彰

Landlords must comply with basic safety rules or risk losing their licence. (房東必須遵守基本安全規定，否則可能失去執照。)
The composer drew inspiration from traditional songs collected in remote mountain communities. (這位作曲家從偏遠山區社群收集的傳統歌曲中汲取靈感。)

meaning:
n. 合成物；複合材料
adj. 複合的；合成的
example: Researchers created a composite index from income, education, health, and housing indicators. (研究人員以收入、教育、健康與住房指標建立綜合指數。)
Listening comprehension improves when learners regularly hear a wide range of different accents, rather than only their teacher's voice. (學習者經常聽到各種不同口音，而不只是老師的聲音時，聽力理解會進步。)
The computation required thousands of observations before the climate model produced stable results. (氣候模型需要納入數千筆觀測資料，才能產生穩定的計算結果。)
The park was conceived as a place where old and young could meet. (這座公園最初的構想，是讓老少都能相聚的地方。)
Her conception of success has changed since she started working with refugees. (自從她開始與難民共事後，她對成功的觀念改變了。)

meaning: adj. 概念上的；觀念性的
example: The early model was only conceptual and never worked as a real machine. (早期的模型只是概念性的，從未真正作為機器運作。)

meaning: adj. 有條件的；取決於……的
example: Conditional funding requires universities to meet specific reporting standards each year before funds are renewed. (有條件的經費要求大學每年達到特定的報告標準，才能續獲撥款。)
Heat conduction through the metal rod increased when one end was placed over a flame. (金屬棒一端放在火焰上方時，熱能透過棒身傳導的速度增加。)
Orange traffic cones marked the edge of the roadworks on the motorway. (橘色交通錐標出高速公路上施工範圍的邊界。)
The seating configuration can be changed quickly for concerts or business conferences. (座位配置可以快速更換，以配合音樂會或商務會議。)

meaning:
vt. 限制；使受困於

Unexpected rainfall can confound the results when researchers compare soil samples from different sites. (研究人員比較不同地點的土壤樣本時，突如其來的降雨可能會干擾結果。)
A connector linked the sensor to a computer, allowing researchers to record signals continuously. (連接器把感測器接上電腦，讓研究人員能持續記錄訊號。)
The word carries a negative connotation in this historical context, despite its neutral dictionary definition. (儘管字典定義中性，這個詞在此歷史脈絡裡仍帶有負面含意。)

meaning: adj. 有意識的；察覺到的
example: She was conscious of every sound while waiting in the dark room. (在黑暗的房間裡等待時，她察覺到每一個聲響。)
Consciousness remains difficult to define, although researchers have identified several patterns in brain activity. (儘管研究人員已找出幾種腦部活動模式，意識仍難以明確定義。)
There is growing scientific consensus that sugar should be heavily taxed, although the food industry still strongly disagrees. (科學界越來越有共識認為糖應被課重稅，儘管食品業仍強烈反對。)

meaning:
n. 同意；許可
v. 同意；允許
example: Participants gave informed consent after researchers explained the study's risks, goals, and data protections. (研究人員說明研究風險、目標與資料保護措施後，參與者才提供知情同意。)

Simple changes at home can conserve both water and electricity quite cheaply. (在家做點簡單改變，就能以很低的成本同時節約水和電。)
The new constitution clearly limits presidential power, although critics say several key articles remain deliberately vague and weak. (新憲法明確限制總統權力，儘管批評者說有幾條關鍵條文仍刻意含糊而薄弱。)
Limited funding severely constrained what the small research team could realistically achieve. (有限的經費嚴重限制了這個小型研究團隊實際能達成的成果。)
Public consultation allowed residents to comment on the transport plan before construction began. (工程開始前，公開諮詢讓居民有機會對交通計畫提出意見。)
Overall household energy consumption falls sharply when older buildings are properly insulated. (老舊建築妥善隔熱後，家庭能源消耗整體會大幅下降。)
The laboratory stored soil samples in a sealed container to prevent moisture from changing their composition. (實驗室把土壤樣本存放在密封容器內，避免水分改變其組成。)
Drought has affected almost every country on the continent during the past year. (過去一年，乾旱幾乎影響了這片大陸上的每個國家。)
The new manager promised continuity in the store's friendly service and fair prices. (新經理承諾延續這家店親切的服務和合理的價格。)

meaning:
n. 輪廓；等高線
vt. 使呈曲線；沿輪廓塑形
example: Researchers mapped the contour of the valley before assessing its flood risk. (研究人員在評估洪水風險前，先繪製山谷的輪廓。)
The witness contradicted her earlier statement when the police showed her the photographs. (警方出示照片時，證人推翻了自己先前的說法。)
There is a clear contradiction between the company's green claims and its actions. (公司的環保說法和實際行動之間有明顯矛盾。)

meaning: adj. 互相矛盾的；不一致的
example: The two reports offered contradictory explanations for the decline in local bird populations. (兩份報告對當地鳥類數量下降提出了互相矛盾的解釋。)

meaning:
adj. 相反的；違背的
n. 相反情況；對立面

The two rivers converge near the city before flowing together into a broad coastal estuary. (兩條河在城市附近匯合，接著一同流入寬廣的海岸河口。)
The convergence of climate data and public health records revealed new regional risk patterns. (氣候資料與公共衛生紀錄的整合，揭示了新的區域風險模式。)

meaning:
v. 協調；統籌
n. 座標；同等者
adj. 同等的；並列的

Coordination between clinics and schools improved vaccination access in remote districts during the winter campaign. (冬季宣導期間，診所與學校協調合作，改善了偏遠地區的疫苗接種服務。)
The old cord on the blind snapped, so we could not close it against the bright afternoon sun. (窗簾的舊繩斷了，所以我們無法拉上它來擋住午後明亮的陽光。)

meaning: adj. 冠狀動脈的；心臟的
example: Coronary arteries supply blood to the heart, and blockages can cause serious medical emergencies. (冠狀動脈負責供血給心臟，阻塞可能引發嚴重的醫療急症。)
The editor issued a correction after readers identified an error in the published report. (讀者發現已刊出的報告有錯誤後，編輯發布了更正。)
Researchers found that exercise levels correlate with improved sleep among university students during examination periods. (研究人員發現，考試期間大學生的運動量與睡眠改善有關。)
There is a clear correlation between average household income and life expectancy. (平均家庭收入和預期壽命之間有明顯相關。)

The cerebral cortex processes information related to memory, language, and voluntary movement. (大腦皮層處理與記憶、語言及自主動作相關的資訊。)

The reports were critically reviewed by specialists before publication in the international journal. (這些報告在刊登於國際期刊前，經過專家的嚴格審查。)
Her critique of the survey exposed assumptions that had excluded rural households from the analysis. (她對調查的評論揭露了分析中排除鄉村家戶的假設。)
Crude oil prices rose sharply after the pipeline was damaged by flooding. (管線因洪水受損後，原油價格大幅上漲。)
The salt forms small crystals as the water slowly evaporates in the sun. (水分在陽光下慢慢蒸發時，鹽會形成小結晶。)
She took his long silence as a cue to change the subject. (她把他長時間的沉默當成改變話題的暗示。)
The school added farming to the curriculum so pupils could learn practical skills. (學校把農務納入課程，讓學生能學到實用技能。)
The engine has four cylinders, each fitted with a small fuel injector. (這具引擎有四個汽缸，每個都裝有小型噴油嘴。)

meaning:
adj. 潮濕的；微濕的
n. 潮氣；濕氣
vt. 使潮濕；抑制

The novelist missed the final deadline again, forcing the publisher to delay the entire book publication until autumn. (小說家又錯過最後期限，迫使出版社把整本書延到秋天出版。)

meaning:

The advertisement deceived many buyers into thinking the shoes were real leather. (這則廣告讓許多買家誤以為鞋子是真皮。)

meaning:
n. 缺陷；瑕疵
vi. 叛逃；變節

Deflection of sunlight by atmospheric particles can reduce temperatures at Earth's surface. (大氣粒子使陽光偏轉，可能降低地表溫度。)

Officials deliberately sampled rural communities to include populations often missed by national surveys. (官員刻意抽樣鄉村社區，納入經常被全國調查漏掉的人口。)

meaning: n. 三角洲；河口沖積地
example: Farmers in the delta grow rice on land that the river refreshes each year. (三角洲的農民在每年河水重新滋養的土地上種稻。)
The demonstrator explained how the low-cost filter removed sediment from drinking water. (示範者說明這款低成本濾水器如何去除飲用水中的沉積物。)

The photographs depict life in the valley before the dam was built. (這些照片描繪了水壩興建之前，山谷裡的生活樣貌。)

meaning:

Developmental research shows how language skills change during a child's first years. (發展研究呈現語言能力在兒童生命最初幾年中的變化。)
A small deviation from the planned route saved the team several hours of travel. (稍微偏離原定路線，反而替團隊省下好幾小時的行程。)
Doctors can diagnose many conditions earlier thanks to portable scanning equipment in rural clinics. (由於鄉村診所有了可攜式掃描設備，醫師能更早診斷出許多疾病。)
The diagnosis depended on test results, patient history, and repeated clinical observations. (診斷結果取決於檢驗結果、患者病史與反覆的臨床觀察。)

meaning:
adj. 診斷用的；判別性的
n. 診斷工具；診斷測驗
example: Diagnostic tests helped researchers distinguish between two infections with similar early symptoms. (診斷檢查幫助研究人員區分兩種早期症狀相似的感染。)
The diagram shows how rainwater is collected and stored under the house. (這張圖顯示雨水如何被收集並儲存在房子下方。)
The older residents still speak a local dialect that younger people barely understand. (年長居民仍說一種年輕一代幾乎聽不懂的當地方言。)
The new pipeline, which measures two metres in diameter, will carry water to remote villages. (這條直徑兩公尺的新管線將把水送到偏遠村落。)
The manager dictated a letter to her assistant before leaving for the airport. (經理前往機場前，口述一封信讓助理聽寫。)

meaning:
n. 差異；微分
adj. 差異的；微分的
example: The differential between the groups narrowed after both received the same educational support. (兩組都獲得相同的教育支持後，彼此的差距縮小了。)
Consumers often cannot differentiate between genuine products and very convincing counterfeit copies. (消費者往往無法區分真品和幾可亂真的仿冒品。)
Differentiation in the classroom gives learners different tasks based on their needs. (課堂中的差異化教學會依學習者的需求提供不同任務。)
Diffusion spreads particles from areas of high concentration toward areas of lower concentration. (擴散會讓粒子從高濃度區域移往低濃度區域。)
The council faces a dilemma between building new homes and protecting green space. (市議會面臨兩難：究竟該興建新住宅，還是保護綠地。)

meaning:

Designers now produce three-dimensional models before any part of the engine is manufactured. (現在設計師會先做出立體模型，才會開始製造引擎的任何零件。)

meaning: n. 二氧化物；二氧化碳

meaning:
n. 指示；指令

Students with a disability requested accessible transport and additional learning support from the university. (有身心障礙的學生向大學要求無障礙交通與額外學習支持。)
The main disadvantage of the flat is its distance from public transport. (這間公寓的主要缺點是離大眾運輸很遠。)

meaning:
n. 排放；出院
v. 排放；解除
example: Factories are no longer allowed to discharge waste into the river untreated. (工廠不再被允許把未處理的廢棄物排放到河裡。)

meaning:
n. 論述；言談
v. 論述；交談
example: Public discourse about housing costs has intensified since rents began rising rapidly. (租金開始快速上漲後，關於居住成本的公共論述變得更加熱烈。)
The survey divided participants into discrete age groups to compare responses across generations. (調查把參與者分成彼此獨立的年齡組，以比較不同世代的回答。)
The law protects workers against discrimination on the grounds of age, sex or disability. (法律保障勞工不因年齡、性別或身心障礙而受到歧視。)
Displacement after the flood forced hundreds of families to seek temporary housing. (洪水過後，數百個家庭因流離失所而必須尋找臨時住所。)
Dissection of the leaf revealed structures that help the plant retain water during drought. (解剖葉片後，可看見幫助植物在乾旱期間留住水分的構造。)

meaning: n. 學位論文；研究論文

Stir the sugar slowly until it dissolves completely in the warm milk. (慢慢攪拌，讓糖完全溶解在溫牛奶裡。)

Any sudden disturbance at night wakes the baby, so the neighbours keep their music very low. (夜間任何突如其來的聲響都會吵醒寶寶，因此鄰居把音樂音量開得很低。)

meaning: adj. 多元的；各式各樣的
example: The city is home to a diverse population drawn from every continent. (這座城市居住著來自各洲的多元族群。)
Artificial intelligence is no longer the exclusive domain of large technology firms. (人工智慧已不再是大型科技公司的專屬領域。)
The dominance of one language can discourage children from maintaining local languages at home. (單一語言占主導地位，可能使孩子不願在家中繼續使用地方語言。)
English remains the dominant language in international business, science and academic research. (英語仍是國際商業、科學與學術研究中的主導語言。)
The domination of a few platforms has reduced competition in online advertising. (少數平台的支配地位，減少了線上廣告的競爭。)
Each donor received a clear report describing how the research grant supported local schools. (每位捐贈者都收到一份清楚的報告，說明研究補助如何支持當地學校。)
The nurse adjusted the dose for small children, carefully checking the child's weight before measuring the exact liquid. (護理師調整兒童的劑量，量取確切藥液前仔細核對孩子的體重。)

meaning:
v. 排水；耗盡
n. 排水管；排水溝
example: The workers drained the pond to remove the rubbish that had collected there. (工人把池塘的水排空，清除積在裡面的垃圾。)
The empty boat drifted slowly towards the rocks until a fisherman caught it. (空船慢慢漂向岩石，直到一名漁夫把它攔下。)
Visitors must remain seated for the duration of the thirty-minute film. (在長達三十分鐘的影片播放期間，訪客必須保持就座。)

meaning:
n. 染料；染色劑
v. 染色；染上顏色
example: The workers dye the cloth in large tanks of very hot water. (工人們在大槽的熱水中把布料染色。)

meaning: adj. 充滿活力的；動態的
example: The neighbourhood has a dynamic local arts scene, with new small galleries opening in former shops every month. (這個社區有充滿活力的地方藝術圈，每個月都有新藝廊在舊商店空間開幕。)
The dam has caused ecological damage that may take decades to repair. (這座水壩造成生態損害，可能需要數十年才能修復。)
She studied ecology and now advises farmers on protecting local wetland wildlife. (她攻讀生態學，現在指導農民保護當地濕地野生動物。)
Economically disadvantaged families often spend a larger share of their income on housing and transport. (經濟弱勢家庭通常將較高比例的收入花在住房與交通上。)

meaning: n. 經濟學家；經濟研究者
example: The economist compared employment data before and after the new tax policy took effect. (這位經濟學家比較新稅務政策生效前後的就業資料。)
The study measured the effectiveness of community programs designed to reduce childhood asthma. (這項研究測量了旨在減少兒童氣喘的社區計畫成效。)

meaning:
adj. 詳盡的；精心製作的
v. 詳細說明；闡述
example: The book contains an elaborate explanation of how the immune system works. (這本書詳細解釋免疫系統如何運作。)

meaning:
adj. 有彈性的；可伸縮的
n. 橡皮筋；鬆緊帶
example: Farming incomes are elastic, rising quickly in good years and falling sharply in bad ones. (農業收入很有彈性，好年頭迅速上升，壞年頭則大幅下滑。)
Price elasticity indicates how strongly demand responds when the cost of a product changes. (價格彈性表示產品成本改變時，需求會受到多大程度的影響。)
An electron carries a negative charge and moves rapidly around the nucleus. (電子帶負電，並繞著原子核運行。)
The course covers elementary statistics only, so no previous knowledge is required. (這門課只教授初級統計，因此不需要先備知識。)
Regular reading can elevate a child's vocabulary and confidence in academic writing. (規律閱讀能提升孩子的字彙量與學術寫作信心。)
At this elevation, thinner air makes physical work more difficult for visiting researchers. (在這個高度，較稀薄的空氣讓來訪研究人員更難進行體力工作。)
The elimination of lead from petrol significantly reduced children's exposure to toxic chemicals. (汽油中去除鉛，大幅降低了兒童接觸有毒化學物質的機會。)

meaning:
n. 菁英；精英階層
adj. 菁英的；頂尖的
example: Young elite athletes often train daily, yet many still earn far less than ordinary full-time office workers. (年輕菁英運動員常每天訓練，但許多人的收入仍遠低於一般全職辦公室職員。)
The tiny chip is embedded in the plastic card, which makes it nearly impossible for criminals to copy. (微型晶片嵌在塑膠卡片裡，讓歹徒幾乎不可能複製。)
The emergence of mobile banking changed how rural families saved and transferred money. (行動銀行的興起改變了鄉村家庭儲蓄與轉帳的方式。)
The city's new emission targets are ambitious, yet traffic still continues to grow much faster than public transport. (這座城市的新排放目標很積極，但交通量仍持續增加，增幅遠快於大眾運輸。)
The factory emits thin grey smoke that local residents say smells strongly of industrial chemicals. (工廠排放淡灰色的煙，當地居民表示聞起來有濃重的工業化學氣味。)
The palace where the last emperor lived is now a museum that attracts millions of visitors each year. (最後一位皇帝住過的宮殿，如今是一座每年吸引數百萬遊客的博物館。)

meaning: adj. 實證的；根據觀察的
example: There is little empirical evidence that primary homework actually improves understanding, although many teachers still assign it daily. (幾乎沒有實證證據顯示小學作業確實能增進理解，儘管許多教師仍每天指派作業。)
The device encodes each call so that outsiders cannot listen to it. (這個裝置會將每通電話加密，讓外人無法竊聽。)
Consistent enforcement of fishing rules helped restore several declining coastal species over the last decade. (過去十年持續執行漁業規範，幫助幾種數量減少的沿海物種恢復。)
The charity became an entirely separate legal entity after the recent internal reorganisation. (經過最近的內部改組，這個慈善機構成為完全獨立的法律實體。)
Every new entrant completed safety training before working inside the research laboratory. (每位新進人員都先完成安全訓練，才進入研究實驗室工作。)
This enzyme helps break down fat during digestion, according to the study. (根據這項研究，這種酵素有助於在消化時分解脂肪。)

meaning:
n. 流行病；盛行；蔓延
adj. 流行性的；迅速蔓延的
example: Doctors describe obesity as a growing epidemic, yet prevention still receives far less public funding than treatment does. (醫師將肥胖描述為日益嚴重的流行病，但預防獲得的公共經費仍遠少於治療。)

meaning: n. 流行病學；疾病分布研究
example: Epidemiology helps public health teams identify how diseases spread across different populations. (流行病學幫助公共衛生團隊了解疾病如何在不同族群間傳播。)
Equality in access to education remains a central concern in many rural communities. (許多鄉村社區仍十分關注教育機會的平等。)
The chemical solution reached equilibrium after researchers maintained a constant temperature for several hours. (研究人員維持恆溫數小時後，化學溶液達到平衡。)
Equivalence between the two scales allowed researchers to compare results from separate studies. (兩種量表之間的等值性，讓研究人員能比較不同研究的結果。)
He erased the wrong figures from the board and wrote the correct totals beside them. (他把黑板上錯誤的數字擦掉，在旁邊寫上正確的總數。)
The essence of the proposal is to make public transport cheaper and more reliable. (這項提案的本質是讓公共運輸更便宜、更可靠。)
The two proposals are essentially similar, although they recommend different timelines for implementation. (兩項提案本質上相似，雖然建議的執行時程不同。)
The estimation used household surveys to predict future demand for public transport. (這項估算運用住戶調查預測大眾運輸未來的需求。)

meaning: adj. 倫理的；合乎道德的
example: The trial raised serious ethical questions because patients were not fully told that the treatment was still experimental. (這項試驗引發嚴重的倫理問題，因為病人未被完整告知療程仍屬實驗性質。)
Research ethics require scientists to protect participants' privacy and report results honestly. (研究倫理要求科學家保護參與者隱私，並誠實報告結果。)

meaning: adj. 明顯的；顯而易見的
example: It became evident that rural students lacked reliable internet access for online classes. (鄉村學生缺乏穩定的網路來上線上課程，這點逐漸變得明顯。)
Evolutionary changes in island birds became clear after researchers compared fossil records. (研究人員比較化石紀錄後，島嶼鳥類的演化變化變得清楚。)
The team executed the plan so carefully that nobody noticed the change. (團隊非常仔細地執行計畫，因此沒有人察覺到變動。)
Poor execution turned a sensible plan into a series of expensive mistakes. (執行不力，讓一項明智的計畫變成連串昂貴的錯誤。)
The hospital lacks the expertise needed to treat this rare condition locally. (這家醫院缺乏在當地治療這種罕見疾病所需的專業知識。)

meaning: adj. 明確的；清楚說明的
example: The consent form gave explicit instructions about storing medical records and protecting patient privacy. (同意書明確說明如何保存病歷與保護患者隱私。)
The report explicitly states which participants were excluded and why the sample was limited. (報告明確說明哪些參與者被排除，以及樣本受限的原因。)

meaning:
vt. 利用；剝削
n. 功績；英勇行為
example: Some websites unfairly exploit children's love of games, often encouraging them to spend large sums without parental permission. (一些網站不公平地利用孩子對遊戲的喜愛，常鼓勵他們未經父母允許就花大筆錢。)

meaning: adj. 指數的；急遽增長的
example: Exponential growth in online applications increased pressure on the university's admissions system. (線上申請數量呈指數成長，增加了大學招生系統的壓力。)
The fabric is soft and breathable, so the shirt is comfortable in hot weather. (這種布料柔軟透氣，所以這件襯衫在熱天穿起來很舒服。)
Researchers examined each facet of the policy, including costs, access, and long-term effects. (研究人員檢視政策的各個面向，包括成本、取得機會與長期影響。)
Wide doors facilitate access for visitors using wheelchairs or walking frames. (寬大的門讓使用輪椅或助行器的訪客更容易進出。)
The faculty of law moved into a restored building near the square. (法學院搬到廣場附近一棟整修過的建築。)

meaning:
n. 疲勞；倦怠
v. 使疲倦；使勞累
example: Driver fatigue is a common cause of accidents on long motorway journeys. (駕駛疲勞是長途高速公路行車事故的常見原因。)
Students receive detailed written feedback on every essay soon after submission, helping them understand exactly where their arguments need strengthening. (學生在交作業後不久就會收到每篇文章的詳細書面回饋，幫助他們確切了解論點哪裡需要加強。)
Soil fertility improved after farmers added compost and planted cover crops between harvests. (農民施用堆肥並在兩次收成間種植覆蓋作物後，土壤肥力改善了。)
Dietary fiber supports digestion and can help reduce the risk of certain chronic diseases. (膳食纖維有助於消化，也可能降低某些慢性疾病的風險。)
Sharks are often hunted for their fins, which are used in soup. (鯊魚常因魚鰭而被獵捕，魚鰭被用來做湯。)
Fresh water is a finite resource, yet many factories still waste it. (淡水是有限資源，但許多工廠仍在浪費。)
The knife cut through the flesh of the fruit but not the stone inside. (刀子切開果肉，但沒有切到裡面的果核。)
Working from home gives parents more flexibility over their daily family schedule. (在家工作讓父母在每天的家庭行程安排上更有彈性。)

meaning:
v. 翻轉；快速翻面
n. 翻轉；快速翻動
example: He flipped the pancake too early and it landed on the floor. (他太早翻煎餅，結果掉到地上。)

meaning:
n. 液體；體液
adj. 流動的；不固定的
example: The patient needs plenty of fluids, especially during hot and humid summer weather. (這名病患需要補充大量液體，尤其是在炎熱潮濕的夏天。)
The flux of migrants across the border changed after employment rules were revised. (就業規定修訂後，跨越邊界的移民流動情形也改變了。)
A footnote clarified that the household income figures excluded temporary government support. (註腳補充說明，家戶收入數字未計入政府的臨時補助。)

meaning: adv. 正式地；依照規定地
example: The committee formally approved the revised plan after reviewing public comments and cost estimates. (委員會審閱公眾意見與成本估算後，正式核准修訂計畫。)
The careful formulation of each survey question helped respondents give clearer answers. (每個問題的謹慎措辭，幫助受訪者給出更清楚的答案。)
The new online forum allows residents to raise concerns about local council services. (新的線上論壇讓居民能對地方市政服務提出疑慮。)
The fossil was found by a walker who reported it to the local museum. (這塊化石是一位散步的民眾發現的，他向當地博物館通報。)
Only a small fraction of the city's household rubbish is actually recycled. (這座城市的家庭垃圾只有一小部分真的被回收。)

meaning:
n. 骨折；裂縫
v. 使骨折；使破裂
example: He suffered a small fracture in his wrist after the fall from the wall. (他從牆上摔下來後，手腕有輕微骨折。)
Constant friction between the two departments slowed down almost every major decision. (兩個部門之間持續的摩擦，拖慢了幾乎每一項重大決策。)

meaning:
n. 邊緣；周邊
adj. 邊緣的；非主流的
example: New factories were built on the fringe of the city, close to main roads. (新工廠建在城市邊緣、靠近主要道路的地方。)
The two ecological models are fundamentally different in how they explain population change. (這兩種生態模型在解釋族群變化的方式上有根本差異。)
A fungus has attacked the trees, and many have lost their leaves. (一種真菌侵襲這些樹木，許多樹都掉光了葉子。)
Their music is a fusion of jazz and traditional folk, attracting listeners who rarely enjoy either style alone. (他們的音樂融合爵士與傳統民謠，吸引平常很少單獨喜歡其中任一種風格的聽眾。)

meaning:
n. 儀表；測量標準
vt. 衡量；估計
example: It is difficult to gauge how much progress students have made from one test. (很難從一次測驗判斷學生進步了多少。)
The generalization was based on only two villages, so researchers warned readers about its limits. (這項概括只根據兩個村莊，因此研究人員提醒讀者留意其限制。)
Researchers should not generalize findings from one school to every student in the country. (研究人員不應把一所學校的研究結果推論到全國所有學生。)

meaning: adv. 在基因上；由遺傳決定地
example: The two crops are genetically similar, but they respond differently to drought. (這兩種作物在基因上相似，但對乾旱的反應不同。)
Advances in genetics have made it possible to identify inherited diseases earlier. (遺傳學的進展讓人能更早發現遺傳疾病。)
Local residents described the abandoned building as a ghost of the town's industrial past. (當地居民形容這棟廢棄建築，是小鎮工業往昔留下的幽靈。)

meaning: n. 全球化；全球一體化
example: Globalization has expanded trade, while raising concerns about wages and working conditions. (全球化擴大了貿易，也引發對薪資與工作條件的憂慮。)
The temperature gradient across the lake influenced where fish gathered during winter. (湖面各處的溫度梯度，影響魚群在冬季聚集的位置。)

meaning: adj. 符合文法的；語法正確的
example: The sentence is grammatical, but its meaning remains unclear without additional context. (這個句子符合文法，但缺少額外脈絡時，意思仍不清楚。)
The graph clearly shows local infection rates falling gradually after the vaccination programme finally began in rural districts. (這張圖表清楚顯示，疫苗接種計畫終於在鄉村地區展開後，當地感染率逐漸下降。)

meaning:
vt. 理解；掌握
n. 理解；掌握
example: It took me a while to grasp the main idea of the lecture. (我花了一段時間才理解這堂課的主旨。)
Astronauts must exercise daily because low gravity quickly weakens muscles on the station. (太空人必須每天運動，因為低重力會迅速削弱太空站上的肌肉。)
The small remote village was finally connected to the grid, ending years of dependence on noisy diesel generators. (這座偏遠小村終於接上輸電網，結束多年依賴吵雜柴油發電機的日子。)
The film earned a gross income of ten million dollars in its first week. (這部片第一週的總收入達一千萬美元。)
Building the new road will destroy the remaining habitat of several small rare butterflies, according to local naturalists. (當地自然學家指出，興建新道路將摧毀幾種稀有蝴蝶僅存的棲息地。)
The study was halfway complete when funding ended, leaving several communities without follow-up visits. (經費結束時，研究只完成一半，幾個社區因此沒有後續訪查。)
The teacher gave each student a one-page handout summarising the main points. (老師給每位學生一張摘要重點的單頁講義。)

meaning:
v. 收割；採收
n. 收成；收穫季
example: Workers harvest the grapes by hand in order to avoid damaging the fruit. (工人用手收割葡萄，以免損傷果實。)
A hawk circled above the field, watching for mice in the grass. (一隻鷹在田野上空盤旋，留意草裡的老鼠。)
The charity's headquarters moved into a former school, giving local staff far more space at lower cost. (這家慈善機構的總部搬進一所舊學校，讓當地員工以更低成本獲得更大的空間。)
A thick hedge separates the quiet garden from the busy main road. (一道茂密的樹籬把寧靜的花園與繁忙的道路隔開。)
Hepatitis can damage the liver, although some forms cause few symptoms during early infection. (肝炎可能損害肝臟，不過有些類型在感染初期幾乎沒有症狀。)
Farmers applied herbicide carefully to control weeds without damaging nearby crops or wetlands. (農民謹慎施用除草劑控制雜草，避免傷害附近作物或濕地。)
In many companies the old hierarchy is giving way to flatter teams that make decisions faster. (在許多公司裡，舊有的階層體制正被決策更快的扁平化團隊取代。)

meaning: adv. 歷史上；從歷史來看
example: Historically, rivers connected inland communities long before railways and paved roads were built. (從歷史上來看，鐵路與鋪設道路出現前，河流早已連結內陸社區。)
Dark clouds gathered along the horizon, warning the sailors that a powerful storm was rapidly approaching the small harbour. (烏雲沿著地平線聚集，警告水手們一場強烈風暴正快速逼近這座小港。)

meaning:
adj. 水平的；橫向的
n. 水平線；橫線
example: Draw a horizontal line across the page and label the two ends. (在頁面上畫一條水平線，並標示兩端。)
The level of this hormone rises during the night and falls again in the morning. (這種荷爾蒙的濃度在夜間上升，早上又下降。)
Buses powered by hydrogen produce only water vapour from their exhaust pipes. (以氫氣為動力的公車，排氣管只會產生水蒸氣。)

meaning: adj. 相同的；完全一致的
example: The two samples looked identical at first, but laboratory tests later revealed a slight chemical difference in composition. (這兩個樣本起初看起來完全相同，但實驗室檢測後來發現成分上有輕微化學差異。)
All visitors must show valid identification before entering the main government building. (所有訪客進入政府大樓前都必須出示有效身分證明。)

meaning: n. 意識形態；思想體系
example: The party's ideology has changed considerably since it first took power in 1990. (這個政黨的意識形態自首次執政以來已有相當大的改變。)
Mirrors in the exhibition create the illusion that the room has no walls. (展覽中的鏡子營造出這個房間沒有牆壁的錯覺。)

meaning: adj. 免疫的；不受影響的
example: People who have recovered from the virus are not necessarily immune to it. (感染病毒後康復的人不一定就對病毒免疫。)
Tourism has had a damaging impact on the coral reef, despite strict new rules limiting local visitor numbers. (儘管新規定嚴格限制當地遊客人數，觀光仍對珊瑚礁造成破壞性影響。)
There was an implicit warning in his tone when he mentioned the deadline. (他提到截止期限時，語氣裡帶著含蓄的警告。)

meaning: adv. 重要的是；尤其重要地
example: Importantly, participants could withdraw from the study at any time without losing services. (重要的是，參與者可隨時退出研究，而不會因此失去服務。)
On an impulse, she bought a ticket and joined the trip south. (她一時衝動買了票，加入了南下的旅程。)
The incidence of asthma increased in neighborhoods with heavy traffic and limited green space. (交通繁忙且綠地有限的社區，氣喘發生率上升了。)

meaning:
v. 傾向於；使傾斜
n. 斜坡；坡度

meaning:

meaning: adj. 本土的；原生於某地的

meaning: adj. 間接的；非直接發生的

meaning: n. 就職輔導；新進人員培訓

meaning: adv. 不可避免地；必然地

meaning: vt. 感染；傳染；使受影響

meaning: adj. 傳染性的；有感染力的
example: Because the illness is highly infectious, visitors must wear masks and wash their hands before entering. (由於這種疾病傳染性很高，訪客進入前必須戴口罩並洗手。)
From the empty shelves, she drew the inference that supplies had run out. (她看到貨架空了，便推論補給品已經用完。)

meaning:
adj. 較差的；品質較低的
n. 下級者；地位較低的人
example: Cheaper materials often produce inferior products that fail within a year or two. (較便宜的材料常會製成品質較差的產品，這些產品一兩年內就會故障。)

meaning: adj. 無限的；無窮無盡的

meaning: adj. 有影響力的；重要的
example: The influential book clearly changed how many local planners thought about transport, shifting policy towards urban public transit. (這本有影響力的書明顯改變許多地方規劃者對交通的看法，使政策轉向城市大眾運輸。)

meaning: adj. 非正式的；不拘禮節的

meaning: n. 抑制；心理拘束；顧忌

meaning:

meaning: n. 開始；啟動；入會儀式

The nurse injected the vaccine into his upper arm and gave him a leaflet. (護士把疫苗注射進他的上臂，並給他一張說明單。)

meaning: n. 注射；針劑；注入；投入

meaning: adj. 天生的；與生俱來的

Insects play a vital role in pollinating crops and breaking down waste. (昆蟲在作物授粉和分解廢棄物方面扮演重要角色。)

meaning:

meaning: adj. 不可或缺的；必要部分

meaning: vi. 介入；介於兩者之間

meaning: n. 面試官；進行訪談的人

meaning: n. 入侵；武力進入某地

meaning:

meaning: n. 實驗室；拉布拉多犬

meaning: adj. 側面的；水平的；橫向的

meaning: n. 配置；版面設計；布局

meaning:

Drivers who ignore the speed limit are liable to cause serious accidents. (忽視速限的駕駛很可能造成嚴重事故。)

meaning: n. 生活方式；日常生活習慣

meaning: n. 肢體；手臂或腿；樹枝；樹木的大枝幹

meaning: adj. 語言的；與語言相關的

meaning: adj. 合乎邏輯的；推理合理的

meaning: adj. 縱向的；長期追蹤的

meaning:

meaning:

meaning: n. 機械；一組機器設備

meaning: adj. 磁性的；帶有磁力的

meaning: n. 規模；大小；重要性；震級

meaning: vt. 操縱；操控；（巧妙地）處理

meaning: n. 操縱；操控；（用手）操作

meaning:

meaning: adj. 微小的；次要的；邊緣的

meaning: adj. 數學的；與數學相關的

meaning: vt. 使最大化；充分利用

meaning: adj. 機械的；機器的；呆板的

meaning: adj. 極少的；最小限度的

meaning: vt. 使減到最低；盡量減少
example: The new schedule will minimize waiting times while keeping specialist clinics open throughout the week. (新時程表會盡量縮短等候時間，同時讓專科門診整週開診。)
The museum displays a decommissioned missile, reminding local visitors how close the whole region once came to war. (博物館展出一枚已除役的飛彈，提醒當地訪客整個地區曾多麼接近戰爭。)

meaning: n. 移動能力；流動性；機動性
example: Improved public transport gives older residents greater mobility and helps them remain active in their communities. (大眾運輸改善後，年長居民的移動能力提高，也更能持續參與社區活動。)
A small modification to the engine improved fuel use by almost ten percent. (引擎經過小幅修改後，燃油效率提高了將近一成。)

meaning: adj. 分子的；與分子相關的
example: Molecular analysis revealed that the samples came from two distinct plant species growing nearby. (分子分析顯示，這些樣本來自附近生長的兩種不同植物。)
This single molecule blocks the virus, which may clearly explain why the new drug works so surprisingly quickly. (這個分子能阻擋病毒，或許可以解釋新藥為何見效如此迅速。)
The recycling campaign gained momentum after a famous actor publicly supported it. (一位知名演員公開支持後，資源回收運動的聲勢逐漸壯大。)
The central bank introduced monetary measures to limit inflation without slowing investment in small businesses. (中央銀行採取貨幣措施抑制通膨，同時避免減緩小型企業投資。)
The company's monopoly on rail services has kept ticket prices unusually high. (這家公司壟斷鐵路服務，使票價一直高得異常。)
The morality of using artificial intelligence in courts deserves careful public debate, not a hasty decision by officials. (在法庭使用人工智慧的道德問題值得公開審慎辯論，不該由官員倉促決定。)
Infant mortality has fallen sharply since clean drinking water became widely available. (乾淨飲用水普及後，嬰兒死亡率大幅下降。)
A recurring motif of migration appears in the poems, connecting family memories with changing landscapes. (詩中反覆出現遷徙的主題，將家庭記憶與不斷變化的景觀連結起來。)
The police could find no clear motive for the strange overnight break-in. (警方找不出這起離奇夜間闖入事件的明確動機。)

meaning:
adj. 跨國的；多國的
n. 跨國公司
example: The multinational employs half the town, so its sudden decision to close would devastate the entire local economy. (這家跨國公司僱用全鎮一半的人，因此突然決定關廠會重創整個地方經濟。)
A rare mutation allows some plants to survive in extremely salty soil. (一種罕見的突變讓某些植物能在鹽分極高的土壤中存活。)

meaning: n. 神話；迷思；錯誤觀念
example: The report challenges the myth that students learn best when every lesson is delivered online. (這份報告挑戰了「學生每堂課都在線上進行才能學得最好」的迷思。)
The committee identified one major weakness, namely that the survey excluded residents without internet access. (委員會指出一項主要缺點，也就是調查排除了無法上網的居民。)

meaning: adj. 嚴重的；討厭的；令人不快的；惡意的；令人反感的
example: He caught a nasty infection while travelling and spent three uncomfortable days in a local hospital. (他旅行時感染了嚴重的疾病，並在當地醫院度過難受的三天。)

meaning: n. 民族主義；國家主義
example: Rising nationalism influenced the election campaign, especially debates about trade and immigration policy. (日益高漲的民族主義影響了選舉活動，尤其是有關貿易和移民政策的辯論。)

meaning: n. 必要；必需品；必要性
example: For many remote households, a reliable internet connection is now a necessity. (對許多偏遠地區的家庭來說，可靠的網路連線如今已是必需品。)
Neural activity changed when participants listened to music that recalled important personal memories. (參與者聆聽喚起重要個人回憶的音樂時，神經活動出現變化。)
Each neuron sends electrical signals to other cells, helping the brain coordinate movement and memory. (每個神經元都會向其他細胞傳送電訊號，協助大腦協調動作與記憶。)
The mediator remained neutral and listened carefully to both sides of the dispute. (調停者保持中立，仔細聆聽爭端雙方的說法。)
The small publisher found a profitable niche by producing science books for primary school teachers. (這家小型出版社靠出版給國小教師閱讀的科普書，找到有利可圖的利基市場。)
Nitrogen levels in the soil determine which crops can grow successfully on the farm. (土壤中的氮含量會影響農場上哪些作物能順利生長。)

meaning:
adj. 崇高的；高尚的
n. 貴族；出身高貴的人
example: The scientist pursued the noble goal of providing clean water to isolated communities. (這位科學家追求崇高的目標，希望為偏遠社區提供乾淨飲用水。)

meaning: n. 節點；接點；（植物的）節
example: Each node in the sensor network sends temperature readings to a central computer every five minutes. (感測器網路中的每個節點每五分鐘都會將溫度讀數傳送到中央電腦。)

meaning: adj. 名義上的；名目上的；象徵性的；數量極少的
example: They pay only a nominal rent for the cottage, since the owner wants someone to keep it warm. (他們只付象徵性的少許租金住在這間小屋，因為屋主希望有人讓屋子保持溫暖。)
The sample was small; nonetheless, its results prompted researchers to conduct a larger follow-up study. (樣本數不多，儘管如此，研究結果仍促使研究人員進行規模更大的後續研究。)
The researchers discovered a nonlinear relationship between sleep duration and concentration during difficult tasks. (研究人員發現，睡眠時間與執行困難任務時的專注力之間呈非線性關係。)
Working from home has become the norm in many skilled professional occupations across the country. (在全國許多需要專業技能的職業中，在家工作已成為常態。)

meaning: n. 記號法；符號系統；記法
example: Musicians used a simple notation system to record rhythms that could not be described clearly in words. (音樂家使用簡單的記譜系統，記錄難以用文字清楚描述的節奏。)

meaning: n. 新手；缺乏經驗的人
example: As a novice in photography, he relied on automatic settings for the first year. (由於是攝影新手，他第一年都依賴相機的自動設定。)
The nucleus controls many activities within the cell and contains most of its genetic material. (細胞核控制細胞內的許多活動，並含有細胞大部分的遺傳物質。)

meaning: adj. 數字的；以數字表示的
example: The numerical results supported the hypothesis, although interviews revealed concerns the survey could not measure. (數值結果支持了這項假設，不過訪談也揭露調查無法測量的疑慮。)
Fresh vegetables lose many nutrients if they are boiled for too long. (新鮮蔬菜若煮得太久，就會流失許多營養素。)

meaning: n. 反對；異議；反對意見
example: The neighbours raised an objection to the plan for a new car park. (鄰居對興建新停車場的計畫提出反對。)

meaning: adj. 晦澀的；不容易理解的；鮮為人知的；不出名的
example: The instructions were so obscure that few users could follow them at all. (這些說明太過晦澀，幾乎沒有使用者能照著操作。)

meaning: n. 觀察者；旁觀者；觀察員
example: An independent observer recorded how visitors used the museum displays during the busiest afternoon hours. (一名獨立觀察員記錄了訪客在午後人潮最多時如何參觀博物館展品。)
Visitors must obtain a written permit before camping overnight on the protected beach. (訪客必須先取得書面許可，才能在受保護的海灘過夜露營。)
In the form, write your occupation and the name of your employer. (請在表格上填寫你的職業和雇主名稱。)
The frequent occurrence of flooding has forced residents to reconsider where new homes should be built. (洪水頻繁發生，迫使居民重新思考新住宅應該蓋在哪裡。)
The pair raised four offspring, all of which stayed near the nest. (這對鳥養大了四隻後代，牠們全都留在巢附近。)
At the onset of winter, researchers moved the outdoor equipment indoors to prevent damage from frost. (冬季一開始，研究人員便把戶外設備移到室內，以免遭霜凍損壞。)
From Monday onwards, visitors must book an online time slot, which should reduce queues at the main entrance. (從週一起，參觀者必須在線上預約時段，這應該能減少正門的排隊人潮。)

meaning: adj. 視覺的；眼部的；光學的
example: The optical illusion makes the narrow corridor look much longer, which confuses first-time visitors almost every day. (這個視覺錯覺讓狹窄的走廊看起來長得多，幾乎每天都使初次來訪的人感到困惑。)
Researchers identified the optimal temperature for growing the crop after comparing results from six controlled trials. (研究人員比較六次對照試驗的結果後，找出了種植這種作物的最佳溫度。)

meaning:
adj. 最佳的；最理想的
n. 最佳狀態；最理想的條件
example: These plants grow best at the optimum temperature of about twenty degrees. (這些植物在約攝氏二十度的最佳溫度下生長得最好。)

meaning: adj. 口頭的；口述的；口腔的
example: The course includes an oral examination in which students discuss a current issue. (這門課包含口試，學生要在考試中討論一項時事議題。)
Every living organism depends on clean water, sunlight and a stable temperature. (每個生物都仰賴乾淨的水、陽光和穩定的溫度。)

meaning: vt. 使適應；使熟悉；定方向；使朝向
example: The guide helped new students orient themselves around campus before their first week of classes. (導覽員在新生第一週上課前，協助他們熟悉校園環境。)

meaning: n. 新生訓練；入職說明；方向；取向
example: The compulsory orientation week includes short campus tours, library training and a talk on academic honesty for new students. (必修的迎新週為新生安排簡短校園導覽、圖書館使用訓練，以及學術誠信講座。)
The oscillation of the bridge became stronger as more people crossed it during the evening festival. (傍晚節慶期間，愈來愈多人走過橋面，橋梁的振盪也隨之加劇。)

meaning: adj. 外面的；位於外部的
example: The outer walls were reinforced after engineers discovered cracks near the entrance to the research building. (工程師在研究大樓入口附近發現裂縫後，加固了外牆。)

meaning: n. 出口；宣洩管道；門市；暢貨中心
example: The river outlet was blocked by fallen branches, raising water levels near the university's sports fields. (河道出口被倒下的樹枝堵住，導致大學運動場附近的水位上升。)

meaning:
adj. 頭頂上的；在上方的
adv. 在頭頂上；在上方
n. 間接成本；營運開支
example: The overhead fan moved the hot air around, but it brought very little real relief during the afternoon. (頭頂的電風扇讓熱空氣流動，但下午幾乎沒有帶來真正的涼意。)
The two shifts overlap for an hour so that staff can share information properly. (兩個班別有一小時的重疊時間，讓員工能妥善交接資訊。)
The report begins with a short clear overview, before carefully examining each main finding in much greater detail. (報告先以簡短清楚的概述開場，再仔細深入檢視各項主要發現。)
Iron tools oxidize quickly when they remain wet, so researchers dried every sample before storage. (鐵器持續受潮時會迅速氧化，因此研究人員在儲存前先將每個樣本擦乾。)
At high altitude the air holds less oxygen, so climbers must ascend slowly and monitor their breathing carefully. (高海拔地區的空氣含氧量較低，因此登山者必須緩慢上升並仔細監測呼吸。)

meaning: adj. 疼痛的；痛苦的；令人難受的
example: The painful recovery lasted several weeks, but the athlete gradually returned to training with medical support. (痛苦的復原期持續了幾週，但這名運動員在醫療協助下逐漸恢復訓練。)
The discovery challenged the prevailing paradigm and encouraged scientists to reconsider how the disease spreads. (這項發現挑戰了當時普遍接受的典範，促使科學家重新思考疾病的傳播方式。)
A paradox emerged when better medical care coincided with rising levels of chronic illness among residents. (醫療照護改善的同時，居民慢性病比例卻上升，形成一種矛盾現象。)
The researchers set clear parameters for the study to ensure consistent results. (研究人員為這項研究設定明確的參數，以確保結果一致。)
A parcel arrived for you this morning, but it needs a signature. (今天早上有一個寄給你的包裹送達，但需要簽收。)

meaning: adj. 父母的；與父母相關的
example: Parental consent is needed before the children can join the school trip. (孩子參加學校旅行前需要取得家長同意。)

meaning: adj. 部分的；不完全的；偏袒的；不公正的
example: The report offers only a partial explanation because key documents remain confidential. (由於關鍵文件仍屬機密，這份報告只提供部分解釋。)
The road was partially closed while engineers repaired a damaged bridge near the village. (工程師修理村莊附近受損的橋梁時，道路部分封閉。)

meaning: n. 粒子；微粒；（語法）小品詞
example: Tiny particles of dust in the air make the sunset look red. (空氣中的微小塵粒讓夕陽看起來偏紅。)

meaning: n. 分隔；分割；隔板；隔間
example: The partition separated the quiet study area from the busy student lounge on the ground floor. (這道隔板將安靜的自習區和一樓熱鬧的學生交誼廳分隔開來。)
The scheme offers a clear pathway into engineering, helping young graduates without contacts find work. (這項計畫提供明確的工程領域就業途徑，協助缺乏人脈的年輕畢業生找到工作。)
The museum displayed tools used by peasant families who cultivated the valley for generations. (博物館展示了世代在山谷耕作的農民家庭使用過的工具。)
Periodic reviews help the university identify safety problems before new students arrive each autumn. (定期檢查有助於大學在每年秋季新生入學前發現安全問題。)

meaning:
adj. 周邊的；外圍的
n. 周邊設備
example: The new road runs through a peripheral part of town, away from the shops. (新道路經過城鎮外圍，遠離商店區。)
Mice became a serious pest in the grain store, so farmers finally sealed every crack in the walls. (老鼠成了穀倉裡的大害，農民最後把牆上每一道裂縫都封住了。)
Harmful pesticide residues were found on the affected fruit, prompting the supermarket to quickly remove the entire batch. (受影響的水果被驗出有害農藥殘留，促使超市迅速下架整批商品。)

meaning: adj. 非凡的；令人驚嘆的
example: The research team made phenomenal progress after gaining access to a previously unavailable collection of records. (研究團隊取得先前無法使用的檔案後，取得了非凡的進展。)
The philosopher questioned whether scientific progress always improves the quality of ordinary people's lives. (這位哲學家質疑科學進步是否總能改善一般人的生活品質。)
The debate raised philosophical questions about whether people can be held responsible for every decision. (這場辯論提出哲學問題：人是否能為自己的每一個決定負責。)

meaning: n. 磷酸鹽；含磷的化合物
example: Excess phosphate from agricultural runoff can cause algae to grow rapidly in freshwater lakes. (農業逕流中的磷酸鹽過量，可能使淡水湖泊的藻類快速生長。)

meaning: adj. 攝影的；照片的；（記憶）過目不忘的
example: Photographic evidence from the survey allowed ecologists to estimate changes in the wetland over time. (調查取得的攝影證據讓生態學家得以估算濕地隨時間的變化。)

meaning: adv. 身體上；實際上；物理上
example: Although the treatment is physically demanding, most patients can return to work within several weeks. (雖然這項治療對身體負擔很大，多數病人仍能在幾週內重返工作。)
Her family physician advised her to cut down on salt and walk for half an hour daily. (她的家庭醫師建議她少吃鹽，每天步行半小時。)
Researchers measured physiological responses to determine whether the breathing exercise reduced stress among students. (研究人員測量生理反應，以判斷呼吸練習是否減輕學生的壓力。)

meaning: n. 規劃者；行事曆；計畫本
example: The city planner consulted residents before redesigning the square beside the historic railway station. (城市規劃者在重新設計歷史車站旁的廣場前，先諮詢了居民。)
Workers on the tea plantation earn low wages and live in simple housing. (茶園工人薪資微薄，住在簡陋的房舍裡。)

meaning: adj. 看似合理的；可信的
example: She offered a plausible explanation, but the details did not quite match. (她提出一個看似合理的解釋，但細節並不完全吻合。)

meaning:
n. 插頭；塞子
v. 插入；塞住開口
example: He pulled the plug out of the socket before repairing the machine. (他在修理機器前先從插座拔下插頭。)

meaning:
n. 複數
adj. 複數的；多元的
example: The plural of 'child' is 'children', which is an irregular form in English. (「child」的複數是「children」，在英文中屬於不規則形式。)

meaning: adj. 極地的；截然相反的；兩極的
example: Polar bears depend on sea ice to hunt seals during the winter months. (北極熊在冬季仰賴海冰獵捕海豹。)
Explorers in the early twentieth century raced to reach the South Pole. (二十世紀初的探險家競相抵達南極點。)

meaning: adv. 政治上；與政治相關地
example: The policy was politically popular in cities, although many rural communities opposed its environmental restrictions. (這項政策在城市中頗受政治支持，但許多鄉村社區反對其中的環境限制。)

meaning: n. 作品集；投資組合；一組投資項目
example: Each applicant must bring a portfolio of recent work to the interview on Monday. (每位申請者週一面試時都必須帶一份近期作品集。)
The documentary portrays village life as families adapt to changing rainfall and limited access to clean water. (這部紀錄片描繪了村民家庭如何適應降雨變化及乾淨用水取得不易的生活。)
Her portrayal of migration included personal interviews with affected families rather than statistics alone. (她對遷徙的描繪納入受影響家庭的個人訪談，而不只呈現統計數字。)

meaning: adv. 正面地；正向地；樂觀地；確實地；明確地
example: Students responded positively to the redesigned library, especially its longer opening hours and quieter study areas. (學生對重新設計的圖書館反應正面，尤其喜歡延長開放時間和更安靜的自習區。)
The students designed a poster explaining how plastic waste affects birds along the coastline. (學生設計了一張海報，說明塑膠廢棄物如何影響沿岸鳥類。)

meaning:
n. 研究生
adj. 研究所的
example: She is a postgraduate now and teaches two classes to pay her rent. (她現在是研究生，為了付房租而教兩個班。)
Potassium helps regulate muscle contractions, so doctors monitor its levels in patients with kidney disease. (鉀有助於調節肌肉收縮，因此醫師會監測腎臟病患者的鉀含量。)
Experienced practitioners advised the university on how to improve student mental health services. (資深從業者就如何改善大學生心理健康服務向校方提供建議。)
We need a pragmatic approach that balances cost, safety and public expectations. (我們需要一個務實的做法，在成本、安全與公眾期待之間取得平衡。)
A short briefing will precede the factory tour, so please arrive on time. (工廠參觀前會先舉行簡短說明會，請準時到達。)

meaning: v. 沉澱；使沉澱；使凝固；促使突然發生；加速引發
example: Minerals precipitate from the water as it slowly cools inside the cave. (水在洞穴內慢慢冷卻時，礦物質會從水中沉澱出來。)
Annual precipitation in this region has fallen steadily over the past decade. (這個地區的年降水量在過去十年持續下降。)
Wolves are natural predators that help control the number of deer in the forest. (狼是天然的掠食者，有助於控制森林裡的鹿群數量。)
The prediction of heavy rain proved correct, and the match was cancelled. (大雨的預測應驗了，比賽因此取消。)

meaning: adv. 主要地；大多數情況下
example: The audience was predominantly young, though a few older couples sat at the back. (觀眾大多是年輕人，不過後方也坐著幾對年長夫妻。)
Prejudice often prevents employers from judging job candidates purely on their actual ability and experience. (偏見常使雇主無法單純依據求職者的實際能力和經驗來評估他們。)

meaning:
adj. 初步的；正式開始前的
n. 初步準備；前置階段
example: Preliminary results suggest the water in the lake is cleaner than last year. (初步結果顯示，湖水比去年乾淨。)
I presume the meeting was cancelled because nobody has confirmed the time. (我推想會議取消了，因為沒有人確認時間。)
The prevalence of obesity among children has risen sharply over the past twenty years. (兒童肥胖的盛行率在過去二十年間大幅上升。)

meaning:

example: The upward trend in average temperatures continued even after the city expanded its tree cover. (即使城市擴大樹木覆蓋率，平均氣溫的上升趨勢仍持續。)
Water usage in the city falls sharply during the cooler winter months. (這座城市在較涼爽的冬季月份用水量大幅下降。)

meaning: n. 實用性；效用；公用事業
example: The utility promised to restore power quickly, but some rural homes still waited almost three days. (公用事業公司承諾迅速恢復供電，但一些鄉村住家仍等了將近三天。)
The research group utilized satellite images to monitor changes in forest cover across the mountain range. (研究團隊利用衛星影像監測整個山脈的森林覆蓋變化。)

meaning: adj. 模糊的；不清楚的；含糊的
example: His answer was so vague that nobody understood what he actually planned. (他的回答太模糊，沒有人了解他實際上有什麼計畫。)

meaning: adj. 有效的；合法的；合理的
example: Your ticket is valid for two hours from the time of purchase. (你的票從購買時間起兩小時內有效。)

meaning: n. 有效性；合法性；正確性；效度
example: The study tested the validity of its questionnaire by comparing answers with participants' medical records. (這項研究將問卷答案與參與者的病歷比較，以測試問卷的有效性。)
The valve controls water flow through the pipe, preventing pressure from damaging the old building. (閥門控制水管中的水流，避免壓力損壞這棟老建築。)
The variability of his heart rate worried senior doctors, who ordered further urgent tests. (他的心率變異讓資深醫師擔心，他們安排了更多緊急檢查。)
The variance in test scores decreased after teachers introduced consistent feedback across all classes. (教師在各班採取一致的回饋方式後，考試成績的變異數降低了。)

meaning:
adj. 不同的；變體的；變異的
n. 變體；變種
example: This variant of the virus spreads more easily but causes milder symptoms. (這種病毒變體傳播得更容易，但引起的症狀較輕。)

meaning: n. 向量；矢量；病媒；傳播媒介
example: Mosquitoes act as a vector for disease, carrying infections between people and animals. (蚊子是疾病的傳播媒介，會在人與動物之間傳播感染。)
Thick vegetation covered the hillside after several weeks of warm spring rain. (幾週溫暖的春雨過後，茂密的植被覆蓋了山坡。)
A nurse found a suitable vein before drawing blood from the patient's arm. (護理師從病人手臂抽血前，先找到了適合的靜脈。)
The velocity of the river increases sharply where the rocky channel narrows. (岩石河道變窄的地方，河水流速會大幅增加。)

meaning: adj. 口頭的；言語的；文字的
example: A verbal agreement is difficult to enforce if one side later changes its mind. (如果一方事後改變主意，口頭協議很難強制執行。)

meaning:
adj. 垂直的；直立的
n. 垂直線
example: The climbers followed a narrow vertical crack in the grey rock face. (攀岩者沿著灰色岩壁上一道狹窄的垂直裂縫往上爬。)
The small farm shop finally became viable only after it also started selling simple coffee and hot meals. (這家小農場商店直到也開始販售簡單的咖啡和熱食後，才終於變得可行。)
Honesty is a quiet virtue, but it becomes surprisingly rare when a small lie could save someone embarrassment. (誠實是一種不張揚的美德，但當一個小謊言能讓人免於尷尬時，它竟變得異常罕見。)
A lack of vitamin D can weaken bones, especially during the winter months. (缺乏維生素 D 會使骨骼變弱，尤其是在冬季。)
Reading widely is one of the most effective ways to expand your vocabulary. (廣泛閱讀是擴充詞彙最有效的方法之一。)
She joined the community orchestra of her own volition, even though rehearsals ended late. (儘管排練結束得很晚，她仍出於自願加入了社區管弦樂團。)
The court ruling became a watershed in the campaign for equal access to public education. (這項法院裁決成為爭取平等接受公共教育的運動中的一個轉捩點。)
The sensor detects each wavelength of light and records how much the surface reflects. (感測器會偵測每種光的波長，並記錄表面反射了多少光。)
Local women weave baskets from reeds that grow beside the shallow lake. (當地婦女用淺湖邊生長的蘆葦編織籃子。)
Wheat is the main crop in this area and is used for flour. (小麥是這個地區的主要作物，用來製成麵粉。)
The grant offers a clear process whereby small museums can request funds for repairs. (這項補助提供明確流程，讓小型博物館藉此申請修繕經費。)

meaning: det. 無論哪一個；不論何者
example: Choose whichever route feels safest when the mountain path becomes narrow after rain. (下雨後山路變窄時，選擇你覺得最安全的任何一條路。)
Whoever arrives first should unlock the hall and switch on the lights for everyone. (無論誰先到，都應該先開大廳的門並替大家開燈。)

meaning: adj. 普遍的；廣泛流傳的
example: There is widespread agreement that the old bus station must be rebuilt. (人們普遍認為，舊巴士站必須重建。)
Traditional wisdom about the weather is often supported by years of careful observation. (關於天氣的傳統智慧，往往是多年仔細觀察的結果。)
The university runs a weekend workshop where students practice repairing old bicycles. (這所大學開設週末工作坊，讓學生練習修理舊腳踏車。)
Warm water helps the yeast become active before the baker mixes the dough. (在烘焙師揉製麵團前，溫水有助於活化酵母。)
The practical first-aid course lasts one weekend, yet it covers bleeding, burns and basic emergency resuscitation quite thoroughly. (這門實用急救課只上一個週末，卻相當徹底地涵蓋止血、燒傷和基本緊急心肺復甦。)
The public transport system is generally reliable, but fares have risen sharply. (大眾運輸系統很可靠，但票價已大幅上漲。)
The final report states clearly that the available evidence remains incomplete and unreliable. (最終報告明確陳述，現有證據仍不完整且不可靠。)
The market for small electric cars is expanding faster than most experts expected. (小型電動車市場的成長速度超出大多數專家的預期。)

meaning: n. 服務；公共服務機構
example: The local ambulance service struggles to quickly reach remote farms, especially when heavy snow blocks the mountain roads. (當地救護服務很難迅速抵達偏遠農場，尤其是大雪封住山路時。)
The government announced extra funding for rural schools and small health clinics. (政府宣布為鄉村學校和小型診所提供額外經費。)
Water pollution is the serious issue residents raise most often, especially those living near the old factory. (水污染是居民最常提出的嚴重問題，尤其是住在附近老工廠旁的人。)
The survey results suggest that most local residents support the new cycle lanes. (調查結果顯示，大多數當地居民支持新的自行車道。)
We ordered two bowls of beef noodles and a pot of green tea. (我們點了兩碗牛肉麵和一壺綠茶。)
The company plans to increase wages by about four percent from next January. (公司計劃從明年一月起加薪約百分之四。)
The radio programme explores how migration has shaped the music of the city. (這個廣播節目探討移民如何形塑這座城市的音樂。)
The visa process took six weeks, mostly because one simple document had been uploaded incorrectly. (簽證流程花了六週，主要是因為一份簡單文件上傳錯誤。)
The new local scheme supports families who are caring full-time for frail elderly relatives at home. (這項新的地方方案支援在家全職照顧體弱年長親屬的家庭。)
The term 'carbon footprint' is now widely used in everyday conversation about climate. (「碳足跡」這個術語如今廣泛用於日常氣候對話中。)
The new product was tested by hundreds of consumers before it reached the shops. (這項新產品在上架前經過數百名消費者測試。)
The unemployment rate fell slightly last month, according to the latest official figures. (根據官方數據，上個月的失業率略為下降。)
The medicine controls the pain effectively, but unfortunately its main side effect is persistent tiredness during the day. (這種藥能有效控制疼痛，但可惜主要副作用是白天持續疲倦。)
The building has five storeys, and the top floor is a restaurant. (這棟建築有五個樓層，頂樓是一家餐廳。)
The colour of the walls makes the small room feel much brighter. (牆壁的顏色讓這個小房間感覺明亮許多。)

meaning: n. 令人擔憂的事；憂慮
example: A growing concern among local parents is the increasing amount of time children spend staring at small screens. (當地家長越來越擔憂的一件事，是孩子盯著小螢幕的時間不斷增加。)
Learning a second language as an adult takes patience, regular practice and plenty of confidence. (成年後學第二語言需要耐心、規律練習和充分的自信。)
Poor drainage caused the flooding that closed the main road for two days. (排水不良引起淹水，導致主要道路封閉兩天。)
He changed the subject whenever money was mentioned, which made planning the trip difficult. (每次提到錢，他就尷尬地轉移話題，這讓規劃整趟旅行變得很困難。)
Children develop basic language skills fastest when adults talk and read with them regularly, not merely at them. (當大人經常陪孩子說話、閱讀，而不只是對他們說話時，孩子的基礎語言能力發展得最快。)
It does not matter whether you start today or tomorrow, as long as you start. (你今天或明天開始都不要緊，只要真的開始就好。)
Most visa applications require applicants to show recent bank statements covering at least six months of steady income. (大多數簽證申請要求申請人提出近期的銀行對帳單，證明至少六個月有穩定收入。)

meaning: adj. 政治的；政治相關的
example: The debate became political when someone raised the difficult question of local taxation. (有人提出地方稅制這個棘手問題後，這場討論就變得政治化了。)

Passengers were told to remain calm, although smoke was clearly visible at the back of the plane. (乘客被告知要保持冷靜，儘管機艙後方明顯可見煙霧。)

The city funded free bus travel for pensioners on weekday mornings last year. (這座城市去年資助長者在平日上午免費搭公車。)
The recipe involves several slow steps, including resting the dough overnight before baking. (這份食譜包含幾個需要慢慢進行的步驟，包括烘焙前讓麵團靜置一夜。)
Her account of the long journey was vivid, describing the dust, the heat and the kindness of strangers. (她對這趟漫長旅程的敘述很生動，描述了塵土、酷熱和陌生人的善意。)
History shows that technological change often creates new jobs while destroying old ones. (歷史顯示，技術變革往往在消滅舊工作的同時創造新工作。)
Each individual household is responsible for sorting its waste before collection day. (每個家庭都必須在收垃圾日前自行分類垃圾。)
Recent research suggests that short naps can improve afternoon performance at work. (最近的研究顯示，短暫午睡能提升下午的工作表現。)
The law now requires all new buildings to meet strict energy efficiency standards. (法律現在要求所有新建築都必須達到嚴格的能源效率標準。)
The architect built a detailed model of the housing project out of cardboard. (建築師用厚紙板做了一個住宅計畫的詳細模型。)
The new library design uses large windows and plenty of natural light. (新圖書館的設計採用大面窗戶和充足的自然光。)
The patient's serious condition improved gradually after major surgery, although he still needs supplementary oxygen every single night. (病人嚴重的病況在大手術後逐漸改善，不過他每晚仍需補充氧氣。)
Her overall position in the race improved steadily, although she never quite caught the two leaders ahead of her. (她在比賽中的總排名穩定進步，儘管始終沒能追上領先的兩名選手。)
The housing situation has improved slightly since the new flats were completed. (新公寓完工後，住宅狀況已略有改善。)
The major cause of avoidable illness in the region is still untreated water, not lack of local hospitals. (這個地區可避免疾病的主要成因仍是未經處理的水，而非缺乏當地醫院。)
The local library has become a meeting place for the whole community. (當地圖書館已成為整個社區的聚會場所。)

The new manager improved customer service within a few months, although staff still complain about low pay. (新經理幾個月內改善了客服品質，但員工仍不斷抱怨薪資太低。)

meaning: adj. 經濟上的；經濟相關的
example: Many young people leave for economic reasons, even though their home town offers a quieter and cheaper life. (許多年輕人基於經濟理由離開，儘管家鄉提供更安靜、更便宜的生活。)

A surprising amount of rain fell in just two hours, which flooded the lower streets of the town. (短短兩小時內降下驚人數量的雨，淹沒了小鎮地勢較低的街道。)
Building work on the site stopped after workers found ancient stone remains. (工人在工地發現古代石造遺跡後，工程就停工了。)
Thousands of families claim monthly housing benefit, yet the application process often remains very slow and confusing. (數千個家庭申請每月住房補助，但申請流程往往仍非常緩慢且令人困惑。)
The private clinic offers a wide range of treatments, from simple physiotherapy to surgery for serious joint problems. (這家私人診所提供各式各樣的療程，從簡單的物理治療到嚴重關節問題的手術都有。)

The tourism industry provides work for thousands of local families in the region. (觀光產業為該地區數千個本地家庭提供工作。)
The quality of air in the city has improved since diesel buses were replaced. (自從柴油公車汰換後，這座城市的空氣品質已改善。)
His account of the accident does not accord with the evidence from the cameras. (他對事故的說法與監視器拍到的證據不一致。)
The restoration project attracted hundreds of volunteers, who cleared weeds and rebuilt a short stretch of old railway. (這項修復專案吸引數百名志工，他們清除雜草並重建了一小段舊鐵路。)
Regular adult smokers face a much higher risk of serious heart disease than non-smokers. (有規律吸菸習慣的成年人罹患嚴重心臟病的風險遠高於不吸菸者。)
The harbour expansion gave local firms an opportunity to win overseas contracts. (港口擴建讓本地企業有機會贏得海外合約。)
Access to education remains unequal between rural and urban areas of the country. (該國城鄉之間的教育機會仍然不平等。)
One clear benefit of working from home regularly is that employees save both commuting time and a considerable amount of money. (規律居家辦公的一項明顯益處，是員工同時省下通勤時間和可觀的金錢。)
The school's standard of teaching has improved since experienced staff began closely mentoring newly qualified colleagues every week. (自從資深教師每週密切指導新進教師後，這所學校的教學水準便提升了。)
His exam performance suffered, mainly because he had slept very little the night before. (他的考試表現受了影響，主要是因為前一晚睡眠不足。)
Local culture is celebrated in the festival through music, food and dance. (這個節慶透過音樂、食物和舞蹈慶祝當地文化。)
Drivers must focus on the road in thick fog, since visibility can fall dramatically within seconds. (駕駛在濃霧中必須專注於路面，因為能見度可能在幾秒內大幅下降。)

meaning: adj. 到期應還的；預定應交的
example: The borrowed library book is due back on Friday, but she has not quite finished reading it yet. (借來的圖書館書週五到期應還，但她還沒完全讀完。)
Digital technology has changed how people shop, bank and communicate with friends. (數位科技改變了人們購物、理財和與朋友溝通的方式。)
The field has been left uncultivated for years and is now full of wild flowers. (這片原野已荒廢多年，現在長滿野花。)
The clinic provides useful reading material for waiting patients, which makes the long queues feel much less frustrating. (診所為候診病人提供實用的閱讀材料，讓漫長的排隊感覺不那麼令人挫折。)

The cathedral was built in the twelfth century and still holds daily services. (這座大教堂建於十二世紀，至今仍每天舉行禮拜。)
Careful analysis of the local river samples revealed traces of pesticide, prompting officials to warn nearby farmers immediately. (仔細分析當地河水樣本後發現農藥殘留，促使官員立即警告附近農民。)

There is clear evidence of ancient settlement here, including tools and the remains of a small stone wall. (這裡有古代定居的明確證據，包括工具和一道小石牆的殘跡。)
The city significantly reduced speed limits near local schools, and serious accidents fell sharply within the first year. (市政府大幅調降當地學校附近的速限，嚴重事故在第一年內就明顯減少。)
The former international champion now quietly coaches young local teenagers, although she rarely talks about her own successes. (這位前國際冠軍現在默默指導當地青少年，儘管她很少談起自己的成就。)
The heating system functions well, but the controls are difficult to understand. (暖氣系統運作良好，但控制面板很難理解。)
Cost is an important factor in the decision, but passenger safety must come first. (成本是這項決定中的重要因素，但乘客安全必須優先。)
She mentioned the serious staffing problem twice, but the manager deliberately and quietly changed the subject both times. (她兩次提到嚴重的人手問題，但經理兩次都刻意悄悄轉移話題。)
Scientists believe several unknown creatures may still exist in the deepest ocean, far below the reach of sunlight. (科學家相信最深的海裡可能仍存在幾種未知生物，遠在陽光到不了的地方。)
The response to the public flood appeal was generous, with donations arriving from towns hundreds of miles away. (民眾對水災募款的反應很踴躍，捐款也從數百英里外的城鎮送來。)
Demand for bottled water soared during the heatwave, and several local supermarkets ran out completely within a few hours. (熱浪期間瓶裝水需求暴增，好幾家當地超市幾小時內就完全售罄。)
Public opinion has shifted in favour of stricter rules on plastic waste. (民意已轉向支持對塑膠垃圾採取更嚴格的規定。)
It is difficult to compare local hospitals fairly, because they simply treat patients with very different needs and budgets. (要公平比較當地醫院很困難，因為它們服務的病人需求和預算差異很大。)
Scientists suppose the storm will gradually weaken by Friday, although coastal residents are wisely preparing for the worst. (科學家推測風暴到週五會逐漸減弱，不過沿海居民仍明智地為最壞情況做準備。)
Family structure has changed greatly in recent decades, and more grandparents now help with daily childcare. (家庭結構近幾十年來變化很大，越來越多祖父母如今分擔日常托育。)
The report relates the decline in fish to pollution from nearby factories. (這份報告把魚群減少與附近工廠的汙染連結起來。)
The phone's standout feature is its battery, which actually lasts two full days even with constant heavy use. (這支手機最突出的特色是電池，即使持續重度使用，實際上也能撐滿兩天。)
He paid by cheque because the small shop still did not accept credit cards. (他用支票付款，因為那家小店仍不接受信用卡。)
The campaign against single-use plastic began in one school, but it soon spread to shops across the entire district. (反對一次性塑膠的活動從一所學校開始，但很快擴展到全區的商店。)
Practical knowledge of first aid can save lives in a serious emergency. (實用的急救知識能在緊急情況下救人一命。)
Many packaged snacks contain hidden salt and sugar, so shoppers should carefully read the labels before buying anything. (許多包裝零食含有隱藏的鹽和糖，因此購物者買任何東西前都應仔細閱讀標示。)
The official report will be published only after the election is completely over. (官方報告要等選舉完全結束後才會公布。)
The article examines why so many young people are leaving rural towns. (這篇文章探討為何有這麼多年輕人離開鄉鎮。)
Poor time management causes many students unnecessary stress, especially when several essays are due in the same week. (時間管理不善讓許多學生承受不必要的壓力，尤其是好幾篇報告同一週截止時。)
The sports section of the local newspaper is longer than the news pages, which annoys some older readers. (地方報紙的體育版比新聞版還長，這讓一些較年長的讀者很反感。)
The shop checked its remaining stock before promising to deliver the sofa. (店家先查看剩餘庫存，才承諾運送沙發。)
Researchers studied the behaviour of commuters during the morning rush hour at two stations. (研究人員在兩個車站觀察通勤者於早上尖峰時段的行為。)
The famous painting represents a busy harbour, though the artist never actually visited the coast during his lifetime. (這幅名畫呈現一個繁忙的港口，不過畫家生前其實從未到過海邊。)
Economic growth has slowed this year, although national unemployment remains relatively low overall. (今年經濟增長放緩，但全國失業率整體仍相對偏低。)
Noise from the nearby airport affects residents' sleep, especially for those living closest to the busy flight path. (附近機場的噪音影響居民的睡眠，尤其是住得最靠近繁忙航道的人。)
They established a small local charity to repair bicycles, giving unused bikes to students who cannot afford transport. (他們成立了一個小型地方慈善組織來修理腳踏車，把閒置的車送給付不起交通費的學生。)
She manages a team of twelve engineers and reports directly to the director. (她管理一支十二人的工程師團隊，並直接向董事回報。)
Scientists developed a new method for testing water quality in remote areas. (科學家開發出一種在偏遠地區檢測水質的新方法。)
The committee will carefully determine eligibility for the grant, using official income records and proof of local residence. (委員會將仔細判定補助資格，依據官方收入紀錄和本地居住證明。)
The influence of social media on teenage sleep has worried doctors for years, yet parents often underestimate it. (社群媒體對青少年睡眠的影響已讓醫師擔憂多年，但家長往往低估了它。)
The average monthly rainfall for July is usually high, but this year the total was far below normal. (七月的平均月雨量通常很高，但今年的總量遠低於正常值。)
The new tunnel brought genuinely significant benefits, cutting the journey for local commuters to the airport by nearly half. (新隧道帶來真正重大的益處，讓當地通勤族前往機場的路程縮短將近一半。)
The region now produces excellent wine, attracting tourists who stay in small family-run guesthouses. (這個地區如今生產優質葡萄酒，吸引許多遊客住在小型家庭旅館。)
Their first attempt to climb the peak failed, but they learned from the experience. (他們第一次嘗試攀登那座高峰失敗了，但仍從這次經驗中學到東西。)
The player signed a two-year contract, but a serious knee injury ended his season after only three matches. (這名球員簽了兩年合約，但嚴重的膝傷讓他的球季只打了三場就結束。)
The economy grew slowly last year because exports fell sharply in the final quarter. (去年經濟成長緩慢，因為出口在最後一季大幅下滑。)

meaning: adj. 各種各樣的；不同的
example: People volunteer for various reasons, from gaining new experience to simply meeting local neighbours in a friendly setting. (人們當志工的理由各種各樣，從獲得新經驗到單純在友善的環境中認識鄰居都有。)
Spending time in nature can reduce stress and improve concentration at work. (花時間親近自然能減輕壓力，並提升工作時的專注力。)
The town's population is ageing quickly, so the clinic now runs weekly special sessions for people over seventy. (這座小鎮的人口正快速老化，因此診所現在每週為七十歲以上民眾開設特別門診。)
The nation has invested heavily in education and public transport since the year 2000. (這個國家自二○○○年以來大力投資教育和公共運輸。)
Landslides often occur on this road after several days of heavy rain. (這條路在連日大雨後經常發生土石流。)
The police issued a brief statement confirming that the busy main road would stay closed until early Friday. (警方發表簡短聲明，確認繁忙的主要道路會封閉到週五清晨。)
Good journalists always respect people's personal privacy, even when a dramatic story might clearly attract far more readers. (優秀記者總是尊重他人個人隱私，即使一則戲劇性報導明顯能吸引更多讀者。)
The government raised tax on cigarettes in order to reduce the number of smokers. (政府提高香菸稅，以減少吸菸人數。)
Children concentrate better in a calm environment, which is why some schools have removed bright displays from classrooms. (孩子在安靜的環境中較能專心，因此有些學校已把教室裡鮮豔的布置撤掉。)
A series of small delays made the journey frustrating, though the train eventually arrived only ten minutes late. (一連串小延誤讓旅程令人煩躁，不過火車最後只晚了十分鐘抵達。)
The purpose of the meeting was to agree on a timetable for repairs rather than to discuss costs. (這場會議的目的是敲定維修時程，而不是討論費用。)
He refused the treatment because it caused severe side effects, and his family eventually accepted that difficult choice. (他拒絕這項治療，因為它造成嚴重副作用，家人最後也接受了這個艱難的選擇。)
All applications are kept in a secure file for at least five years. (所有申請文件都會存放在安全檔案中至少五年。)
The department of transport is reviewing the safety of the old river bridge. (交通部門正在重新評估那座老河橋的安全性。)
She asked a direct question and received a clear answer from the manager. (她問了一個直接的問題，得到經理清楚的回答。)
The main character in the novel is deeply selfish, yet readers still find her strangely sympathetic. (小說主角性格極為自私，但讀者仍覺得她出奇地令人同情。)
The two sides finally reached an agreement on the sharing of water resources. (雙方終於就水資源分配達成協議。)
She studied engineering at a technical college before joining the company full time. (她進入公司前，曾在一所技術學院攻讀工程。)
Hundreds of graduates seek internships abroad to gain experience they cannot get at home. (數百名畢業生尋求海外實習機會，以取得在國內得不到的經驗。)
The city hopes to achieve carbon neutrality by the middle of the century. (這座城市希望在本世紀中葉實現碳中和。)
Some doctors argue that hospitals should offer free evening appointments so that workers need not take unpaid leave. (有些醫師主張，醫院應提供免費的夜間門診，讓勞工不必請無薪假。)
Patients in rural clinics often lack access to specialists, so many travel for hours to see a doctor. (鄉間診所的病人往往缺乏專科醫師資源，因此許多人得花好幾個小時才能看診。)
Cycling is often the fastest option for short trips across the city. (在城市裡短程移動，騎自行車往往是最快的選擇。)
One clear advantage of the online course is flexibility, allowing students to study around their own busy full-time jobs. (這門線上課程的一大優點是彈性，讓學生能配合自己繁忙的全職工作讀書。)
Careful forensic tests identified the victim within a few days. (仔細的法醫檢驗在短短幾天內確認了受害者身分。)
The figures indicate a clear trend, although one bad month could still change the picture. (這些數字顯示出明確趨勢，不過一個糟糕的月份仍可能改變整體情況。)
The family's income fell sharply when the factory reduced its working hours last winter. (去年冬天工廠縮減工時後，這個家庭的收入大幅減少。)
The contract gives no specific date for completing the repairs to the roof. (這份合約沒有明確訂出屋頂修繕完工的日期。)
The class held a lively discussion about whether advertising should be banned in schools. (班上熱烈討論學校裡是否應禁止廣告。)
Most visitors immediately associate this old market with the smell of warm fresh bread and very strong coffee. (多數訪客會立刻把這座老市場和溫熱新鮮麵包及濃烈咖啡的氣味聯想在一起。)
I hardly recognized the square after they removed all the old trees. (他們把老樹全移走後，我幾乎認不出這個廣場。)
Employers increasingly recognise the value of good mental health support for staff. (雇主越來越認可為員工提供良好心理健康支援的價值。)
The winter climb is a serious physical challenge, so always prepare carefully and never go alone. (冬季攀登是嚴峻的體能挑戰，因此一定要仔細準備，且絕不要獨自前往。)
Engineers proposed a simple long-term solution to the noise problem, but many residents doubt it will actually work. (工程師對噪音問題提出簡單的長期解決辦法，但許多居民懷疑它真能奏效。)
The direct relation between pay and job satisfaction is still often far weaker than many experienced managers tend to assume. (薪資與工作滿意度之間的直接關係，仍往往遠比許多資深主管以為的還要弱。)
The theory sounds fully convincing, yet no single experiment has ever produced evidence strong enough to support it. (這個理論聽起來完全有說服力，但從沒有任何單一實驗產生足以支持它的證據。)
Despite a painful knee injury, she finished the marathon and even slightly improved on her previous best time. (儘管膝傷疼痛，她仍跑完馬拉松，甚至略微刷新自己先前的最佳成績。)
The council introduced a new fee for household garden waste, which sharply reduced illegal dumping within just a few weeks. (市議會對家庭庭園廢棄物收取新費用，短短幾週內就大幅減少非法傾倒。)
The results prove that early treatment greatly improves a patient's chances of survival. (結果證明，及早治療能大幅提高病患的存活機會。)
Her ability to stay calm under pressure impressed the senior coach, who had doubted her before the match. (她在壓力下保持冷靜的能力讓資深教練印象深刻，這位教練賽前還曾懷疑她。)
The hospital has modern equipment and a new unit for heart patients. (這家醫院有現代化的設備，還有一間新的心臟病患專用病房。)
The government released the full report on Friday, quietly hoping fewer people would notice its clearly embarrassing conclusions. (政府在週五公布完整報告，悄悄希望較少人注意到其中明顯令人難堪的結論。)

meaning: n. 取得的機會；使用權
example: Rural children often lack access to good local schools, so many families move closer to the nearest town. (鄉村孩子往往缺乏就讀良好本地學校的管道，因此許多家庭搬到最近的城鎮附近。)
The annual conference brings together researchers from more than thirty different countries. (年度會議聚集來自三十多個不同國家的研究人員。)
The school met its annual reading target, but still fell surprisingly short in mathematics despite weekly extra lessons. (這所學校達成了年度閱讀目標，但儘管每週加課，數學表現仍出乎意料地未達標。)
Teachers often underestimate the genuine potential of quieter students, who may produce more thoughtful work when given time. (教師常低估安靜學生的真正潛力，這些學生只要有時間，往往能交出更有深度的作品。)
Neighbours organized a street party to welcome the families who had recently arrived. (鄰居籌辦了一場街頭派對，歡迎最近搬來的家庭。)
The tiles form a pattern of blue stars on a white background. (磁磚在白底上排成藍色星星的樣式。)
The movement for cleaner rivers has gained support from local businesses and schools. (爭取河川潔淨的運動已獲得當地企業和學校的支持。)
